combo.description: To escape from being flanked W R instantly then W again once it's a Gold Card. AA R as quickly as you can.
Use your ultimate to get a pick by using R then R2 and instantly casting W. W again on a Gold Card then instantly AA Q AA.
To bait your opponent W then time your AA with the exact time you W a Gold Card, After that use Q and finally your AA.
To deal damage on your opponent from long range W and lock in a Gold Card then Q. Use F mid animation followed by an instant AA.
To trade nicely with your Gold Card AA then instantly W, AA again then lock in a Gold Card. Quickly instantly AA Q followed by one more AA.
For your bread and butter combo W and lock in a Gold Card then instantly AA Q followed by one more AA.
To poke with your blue card AA then W. AA again, lock in a Blue Card and instantly AA.
W and lock in a Red Card then AA a nearby unit and Q your main target.
